candidate_grammar.boundary: All exact first terminal self-coupling refinements of the admitted three-root product constructed from its generator order, complete generator volume, terminal alpha and forced down/up cover depths.
candidate_grammar.generator: Generate the complete product of base invariant, interaction order, support, down-depth role, up-depth transport, channel distribution, correction orientation, target custody and extension forms.

excluded_inputs: no measured lepton mass or ratio in the executable relation
no floating, irrational, imaginary, semantic-zero or negative proof value
no fitted coefficient, tolerance, selected root or extra correction term
no claim that this post-failure construction was a blind forward discovery
intended_certificate: One engine receipt jointly requiring the 1024-form structural census, exact result, independent reconstruction and both complete CODATA interval comparisons.
statement: The admitted charged-lepton cubic is refined by the complete terminal electromagnetic self-coupling of its three-root product: alpha to the generator-three order is distributed over the complete three-cubed carrier and weighted once by the forced cover-depth pair five and seven, with the up-depth transported through one alpha and one colour channel. The exact correction is held from 3/1454.
title: Terminal self-coupling refinement of the charged-lepton cubic
